mechanism_evidence.contract: download_all owns a per-call working sequence: the working products list is not (is not) the caller SearchResult; consuming (popping) the working copy leaves the caller sequence untouched; captured at the download_all entry timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Download several products with download_all, then keep using the caller-side SearchResult.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The working variable aliases the caller SearchResult; per-product removal empties the caller list in place.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: products = products[:] at the download_all entry (working snapshot before per-product removal).

discriminating_observation.description:
from eodag.api.search_result import SearchResult
prods = SearchResult([object(), object(), object()])
n_before = len(prods)
working = prods[:]
print('identities', working is prods)
assert working is not prods
working.pop(0)
assert len(prods) == n_before, 'side effect: caller sequence consumed'
assert len(working) == n_before - 1
print('f2_download_isolation', True)
